name: cdep
description: Client Data Exchange Protocol: capability discovery and user-approved dataset transfer between browser applications, with no backend.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cdep/protocol && npm run build -w @cdep/formats && npm run build -w @cdep/browser
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/sequence-app/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/tree-viewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-sender/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-receiver/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run e2e
